notes.trinkets: Havoc generally seeks to use one on-use trinket that aligns with Metamorphosis to enhance its burst windows, and then one strong passive trinket to go with it. Both stat procs and damage effects are useful due to Know Your Enemy , so there's a good amount of flexibility on offer.
